annotations.title: Is our premium holding, or are buyers hunting for a cheaper way in?

description: Use when the user asks whether their price premium is holding, whether customers are trading down, or whether a price rise is hurting demand. Returns the share of the brand's US Google searches that look for a cheaper way in (price, cheap, discount, coupon, dupe, alternative, sale), against the year before, with a verdict (eroding, holding, strengthening) and each modifier's trend. Shares and bands only. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For brands' shares of all searches, use run_share_of_search; for which reasons to buy people search for, use run_angle_demand. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/premium-check.json
